challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: The students submitted their assignments on time
challenges.explanation: Subject (The students) + verb (submitted) + object (their assignments) + adverb phrase (on time).

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: She has been studying English since January
challenges.explanation: Present perfect continuous: Subject + has/have + been + verb-ing + time marker.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: Could you please open the window for me
challenges.explanation: Polite request: Could + you + please + base verb + object + prepositional phrase.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: They will have finished the project by tomorrow
challenges.explanation: Future perfect: Subject + will + have + past participle + time expression.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: He rarely goes to the gym on weekends
challenges.explanation: Adverb of frequency (rarely) placed before the main verb (goes).

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: The book that I borrowed from the library was excellent
challenges.explanation: Subject + relative clause (that I borrowed from the library) + verb + adjective.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: We should have left earlier to avoid the traffic
challenges.explanation: Should + have + past participle for past regret. Infinitive of purpose (to avoid).

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: My parents always encourage me to read more books
challenges.explanation: Subject + adverb + verb + object + infinitive clause.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: If it rains tomorrow we will stay at home
challenges.explanation: First conditional: If + present simple, subject + will + base verb.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: She apologized for being late to the meeting
challenges.explanation: Verb + preposition (apologized for) + gerund (being) + adjective + prepositional phrase.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: The weather is too cold to go swimming today
challenges.explanation: Too + adjective + to + infinitive structure.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: Neither the manager nor the employees agreed with the decision
challenges.explanation: Correlative conjunction: Neither + noun + nor + noun + verb.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: He has been working here for ten years
challenges.explanation: Present perfect continuous with 'for' + duration.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: Despite being tired she continued working until midnight
challenges.explanation: Despite + gerund clause + main clause with time marker.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: The children were excited about going to the zoo
challenges.explanation: Subject + were + adjective + preposition + gerund + prepositional phrase.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: Not only did he pass the exam but he also got the highest score
challenges.explanation: Correlative conjunction with subject-verb inversion: Not only + did + subject + verb.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: I wish I had studied harder for the test
challenges.explanation: Wish + past perfect for past regret.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: The teacher asked the students to open their textbooks
challenges.explanation: Reported command: Subject + asked + object + to + infinitive.

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: It was such a beautiful day that everyone went outside
challenges.explanation: Such + a + adjective + noun + that clause (result).

challenges.instruction: Arrange the words into the correct sentence
challenges.correctSentence: She would rather stay home than go to the party
challenges.explanation: Would rather + base verb + than + base verb.
